title: Text: DET Greg Garno ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: I created a fantasy hockey league last night. Aiming for 10 teams, $100. Might be too much but I think there’s gotta be enough of a commitment for it to work. CBS costs $100 and I don’t really want to put the time in running a $20 league. If you’re interested, lemme know.
I sent you an invite anyways, just so you can officially reject my advances
And when you do, let me know if there’s a way you can actually reject it
